summary: First-run testing of Immo Traeum AG MVP. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed covering media assets, listings, valuation (LLM), inquiries, admin auth, chat SSE stream, and no-15-Jahre regression. Frontend: all 8 sections render with no runtime overlay, hero <picture> uses AVIF + WebP srcset (800/1600/2400w) with fetchpriority='high' & decoding='async', Beteiligungen shows the Bundesamt-fuer-Statistik citation, R3F Digital Twin canvas mounts inside Objekte section, listing images serve from /media/dachwohnung-800.webp, Bewertung wizard end-to-end produces a Swiss-formatted valuation (586'177), Kontakt form persists inquiry (admin shows 3 Anfragen), Admin login rejects wrong password and accepts correct one showing 7 seeded objects, dark<->light theme toggle works.

minor.issue: Body validation runs before admin-password check, so requests without X-Admin-Password can return 422 instead of 401. Not a security issue (still rejected) but inconsistent with test expectation and preferred API contract.

issues: AVIF <source> only lists a single hero-2400.avif (no 800w/1600w AVIF variants). WebP srcset is complete (800/1600/2400). Minor: browsers on smaller viewports will download the 2400px AVIF.

action_items: (Optional) Generate hero-800.avif and hero-1600.avif and include them in the AVIF srcset for consistent responsive behaviour.
(Optional) Reorder POST /api/listings to check X-Admin-Password header before Pydantic validation so unauthorised writes return 401 rather than 422.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 531-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (listings, valuation, chat, admin) if it grows further.
Admin auth relies solely on a plain-text header comparison to ADMIN_PASSWORD; adequate for internal admin panel but should be documented (no rate limiting on /api/admin/login).
Chat SSE endpoint has no timeout/size limits; long user prompts could keep the stream open. Fine for MVP.
COMPANY_INFO is embedded inline in server.py and correctly no longer mentions 'Erfahrung: über 15 Jahre.'
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ inquiry created via public /api/inquiries and one TEST_Playwright inquiry via UI. Non-destructive; can be cleaned via admin panel if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers media assets, listings, valuation (real LLM call ~5-10s), inquiries CRUD, admin auth, chat SSE streaming, and no-15-Jahre regression. Chat endpoint expects {session_id, message} not messages[]. Old PNG paths /media/*.png now fall through to the SPA index.html catch-all (text/html) rather than 404 — that is acceptable because the image files are physically removed. React is 18.3.1 by design; do not upgrade.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. Regression fixes (15-Jahre removal + <picture>/AVIF+WebP optimisation) all verified in place.
